risk_flags.clause: The Tenant shall pay a security deposit of $6,000 which is non-refundable under all circumstances.
risk_flags.reason: The deposit is effectively non-refundable; deposits must generally be refundable by law.

risk_flags.clause: A late fee of $150 per day applies to any rent received after the due date.
risk_flags.reason: The late fee accrues per day, which compounds quickly and is a classic unenforceable-penalty pattern.

risk_flags.clause: The Landlord may enter the premises at any time without notice, day or night, for inspection or any other purpose.
risk_flags.reason: The entry clause lets the landlord enter without effective notice limits, violating standard notice requirements.

risk_flags.clause: The Landlord may terminate this lease at any time for any reason with 24 hours notice, and the Tenant must vacate immediately.
risk_flags.reason: The termination/eviction clause is one-sided: termination at will/sole discretion; immediate vacation demanded; only 1.0 days notice (minimum here: 3).

risk_flags.clause: The Tenant waives the right to a jury trial and agrees that all disputes shall be decided by an arbitrator selected solely by the Landlord.
risk_flags.reason: The tenant is made to waive legal rights or protections; such blanket waivers are typically unenforceable but signal intent.

risk_flags.clause: The Tenant waives the right to a jury trial and agrees that all disputes shall be decided by an arbitrator selected solely by the Landlord.
risk_flags.reason: The dispute clause is one-sided: the landlord controls the arbitrator selection or the tenant bears all costs.

risk_flags.clause: The Tenant is responsible for all repairs including structural repairs, roof repairs, and habitability issues at the Tenant's own expense.
risk_flags.reason: Structural/major repair obligations are shifted to the tenant; these are legally the landlord's responsibility.

risk_flags.clause: A penalty of $100 per nail hole will be deducted from the deposit at move-out.
risk_flags.reason: Per-item or outsized penalties (e.g. per nail hole) are punitive charges courts rarely enforce - and a strong bad-faith signal.

risk_flags.clause: Guests may not stay overnight more than one night per month, and any guest stay requires advance written approval.
risk_flags.reason: The guest policy is unusually restrictive (blanket bans or per-stay landlord permission) and intrudes on ordinary quiet enjoyment.

risk_flags.clause: The Tenant agrees never to contact any government authority or housing inspector regarding the premises, and any such contact is grounds for immediate eviction.
risk_flags.reason: The clause punishes lawful complaints to authorities - retaliatory and almost certainly unenforceable, and a serious red flag about the landlord.

risk_flags.clause: This lease automatically renews for a further 12 month term unless the Tenant provides 90 days notice of non-renewal.
risk_flags.reason: Auto-renewal requires 90 days advance notice to escape - an easy trap; 30 days is the norm.

summary: This lease contains several clauses that appear one-sided or potentially unlawful. The strongest concerns are around fees, notice rights, eviction, and repair obligations, and those terms should be revised before signing.
